integrity.computational_role: The checker verifies only a finite rational certificate and algebraic identities; the all-parameter inequality is proved analytically.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact parity arguments, explicit covering witnesses, and an exact rational Voronoi-chamber vertex certificate at the equality parameter.
integrity.unproved_limits: No unrestricted five-dimensional optimality, no arbitrary two-periodic local optimality, and no three-parameter global optimality are claimed.

scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes only the ray \(H_\tau=\operatorname{diag}(1,1,1,1,\tau)\) on the fixed set \(D_5^+\); arbitrary metric and point-set perturbations are outside scope.
A companion note cited by the lead paper could not be inspected publicly and is retained as a literature risk.
title: Exact optimizer on the \(D_5^+\) diagonal packing-covering ray
